summary: Allows a user to like a specific track
description: Marks the track identified by `track_id` as liked by the user associated with the provided `access_token`. If the track does not exist, no error is raised and the track will not appear in any read request. Requires a valid `client_id` (API key) and an `access_token` with the `music` scope.

requestBody.name: client_id
requestBody.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com

requestBody.name: fullcount
requestBody.description: If true, adds the total number of rows that would be returned without limit/offset to the response header

requestBody.name: access_token
requestBody.description: A valid OAuth2 access token with the 'music' scope for the Jamendo user

requestBody.name: track_id
requestBody.description: Identifier of the track to be liked

responseFields.name: headers
responseFields.description: Metadata about the request outcome, including status and result counts

responseFields.name: results
responseFields.description: Array of results; empty for this operation

notes: Both `client_id` and `access_token` are required; `client_id` acts as the API key.
`fullcount` may be unavailable on heavy methods due to performance considerations.
No error is raised if `track_id` refers to a non‑existent track; the operation is silently ignored.
